lesson.$comment: Oren (Q1.6) teaches models and effort, then sends you here: until then every stall's keeper says their `early` line. While Q1.6 is at `market`, Gilda's stall runs his practice (a quick look right-sized, then a hard job and a Retry of it) and stakes you the starfish; then Q1.6 goes to `practiced` and you tell Oren.

$comment: The Model Market (a stall on every island; Gilda's on Port Meridian runs Q1.A): a Copilot-app-only mechanic. You hire Copilot Fusion (the house special, at one of its effort levels) or a category's model with an effort for each job on her board, paying starfish; the grade (right-sized, over, short) is the game's, against the course's guidance on models and reasoning effort. The jobs, prices, refunds, stamps, quotes and the keepers' lines are the pack's market.json; the model list is models.json; this file is the market's words (the overlay, the hire's name, each outcome's summary, the stall's signs and Wingman's hints) and its `lesson`: when the course has taught models (the stalls grade from then on), and the practice Gilda's stall runs for that lesson.
